q1.explanationZh: borrow“借（入）”，borrow sth. from sb.“向某人借某物”；借出给别人用 lend。

q2.explanationZh: boss 名词“老板；上司”，复数 bosses。

q3.explanationZh: botany“植物学”的形容词是 botanical，如 botanical research“植物学研究”。

q4.explanationZh: botany 去 y 加 -ist 表示人，botanist“植物学家”。

q5.explanationZh: botany 名词“植物学”，注意拼写 bot-a-ny。

q6.explanationZh: both 指“两者都”，三者及以上用 all；both...and...“……和……都”。

q7.explanationZh: bother 既可作及物动词“打扰”，也可作不及物动词“烦恼”。

q8.explanationZh: bottle“瓶子”，a bottle of water“一瓶水”；派生词 bottled“瓶装的”。

q9.explanationZh: bottom“底部”，at the bottom of“在……的底部”。

q10.explanationZh: bounce 指球等“弹起，反弹”，可作不及物动词和名词。

q11.explanationZh: bound 作名词“跳跃”，with one bound“一跃”。

q12.explanationZh: boundary“边界”，复数 boundaries（变 y 为 i 加 -es）。

q13.explanationZh: bow 读 /baʊ/ 时是“鞠躬”，读 /bəʊ/ 时是“弓”，拼写相同。

q14.explanationZh: bowl 名词“碗”，动词“打保龄球”，两个意思拼写相同。

q15.explanationZh: bowl“打保龄球”加 -ing 构成 bowling“保龄球运动”，go bowling“去打保龄球”。

q16.explanationZh: box 有“箱，盒”和“拳击，打耳光”两组意思，拼写相同。

q17.explanationZh: box“斗拳”加 -ing 构成 boxing“拳击”。

q18.explanationZh: boy“男孩”，复数 boys（y 前是元音字母，直接加 -s）。

q19.explanationZh: brain“脑；智力”，have a good brain“脑子好使”。

q20.explanationZh: brake“刹车”，与 break“打破”读音相同，注意拼写区别。

q21.explanationZh: branch 名词“树枝；分行”，动词“分叉”，branch out“扩展业务”。

q22.explanationZh: brand 名词“牌子”，动词“铭刻”，be branded on one’s memory“铭刻在记忆里”。

q24.explanationZh: brave 形容词“勇敢的”，也可作及物动词“勇敢面对”；名词 bravery。

q25.explanationZh: bread“面包”是不可数名词，a piece of bread“一片面包”。

q26.explanationZh: break 动词“打破；违反”，名词“休息”，过去式 broke，过去分词 broken。

q27.explanationZh: breakfast 由 break（打破）+ fast（禁食）构成，have breakfast“吃早餐”，前面不加冠词。

q28.explanationZh: breast 名词“胸部”，也可作动词“挺胸迎……而上”。

q29.explanationZh: 名词 breath“呼吸”，动词是 breathe，注意词尾区别。

q30.explanationZh: 动词 breathe“呼吸”比名词 breath 多一个 e，读 /briːð/。

q31.explanationZh: breed 名词“品种”，动词“繁殖”，过去式 bred。

q33.explanationZh: bribe 名词“贿赂”，动词“行贿”，take/accept bribes“受贿”。

q34.explanationZh: bother about/with“为……麻烦、操心”，about 和 with 都可以。

q35.explanationZh: bother to do sth.“特地 / 费心去做某事”，后接不定式。

q36.explanationZh: “弓”是 bow（读 /bəʊ/），“箭”是 arrow，都用复数；with 表示“用”。

q37.explanationZh: hold one’s breath“屏住呼吸”，breath 是名词。

q38.explanationZh: out of breath“上气不接下气”，out of 表示“缺少”。

accept: give sb. a sound box on the ear

q39.explanationZh: box 作名词有“耳光”之意，give sb. a sound box on the ear“掴某人一记响亮的耳光”。

q40.explanationZh: “接受贿赂”= take/accept bribes，bribe 用复数。

q42.explanationZh: break up“打碎；（关系）破裂；（学校）放假”。

q43.explanationZh: break in“闯入；插嘴”，闯入某地也可用 break into。

q44.explanationZh: break through“突破；冲破”，through 表示“穿过”。

q45.explanationZh: break 有“违反”之意，break the law“违法”。

q46.explanationZh: break out“（战争、火灾、疾病等）爆发”，没有被动语态。

q47.explanationZh: break down“（机器、车辆）出故障”，也可指“（情绪）失控”。

q48.explanationZh: break away (from)“脱离；挣脱”，后接所脱离的对象时用 from。

q49.explanationZh: Which brand of...“什么牌子的……”，brand“牌子”。

q50.explanationZh: are 后需要形容词，和 industrious“勤劳的”并列，用 brave“勇敢的”。

q51.explanationZh: a gentle 后接可数名词单数，“今天微风轻吹”，用 breeze“微风”。

q52.explanationZh: branch out into...“把业务扩展到……”，decided to 后用动词原形 branch。

q53.explanationZh: 江有两岸，“两边都”用 both，后接复数名词 sides。

q54.explanationZh: at the bottom of“在……的底部”，指申请表下端。

q55.explanationZh: and 连接两个过去式动词，lit 是过去式，所以用 braked“踩刹车”。

q56.explanationZh: 演员向观众“鞠躬”用 bow，句子是过去时，用 bowed。

q57.explanationZh: a deep 后接名词，take a deep breath“深吸一口气”，名词是 breath 不是 breathe。

q58.explanationZh: were 后接过去分词构成被动语态，“被借的书”用 borrowed。

q59.sampleAnswer: At last the sun broke through the clouds.
references: At last the sun broke through the clouds.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “钻出、冲破”= break through；讲过去的事用过去式 broke。

q60.sampleAnswer: His unhappy childhood has been branded on his memory.
references: His unhappy childhood has been branded on his memory.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: brand 作动词“把……铭刻”，用现在完成时的被动语态 has been branded on。

q61.sampleAnswer: He reluctantly agreed, but what if he breaks his promise by then?
references: He reluctantly agreed, but what if he breaks his promise by then?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “食言”= break one’s promise；what if 引导条件，用一般现在时 breaks。

q62.sampleAnswer: We cannot just sit by while these people break the law.
references: We cannot just sit by while these people break the law.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “坐视”= sit by；“违法”= break the law。

q63.sampleAnswer: No matter how hard I try, I cannot break away from this invisible net.
references: No matter how hard I try, I cannot break away from this invisible net.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “无论多么”= no matter how；“挣脱……”= break away from。

q64.sampleAnswer: Our car broke down halfway and we had to draw it to a garage.
references: Our car broke down halfway and we had to draw it to a garage.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “（车）坏了”= break down，过去式 broke down；“不得不”= had to。

q65.sampleAnswer: His boss spoke highly of him, because he always succeeded in finishing the task.
references: His boss spoke highly of him, because he always succeeded in finishing the task.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “对……评价很高”= speak highly of；“成功地做某事”= succeed in doing sth.。

q66.sampleAnswer: Their marriage is said to have broken up and she broke with her husband last month.
references: Their marriage is said to have broken up and she broke with her husband last month.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “据说”= be said to have done；“婚姻破裂”= break up；“与某人决裂”= break with sb.。

q67.sampleAnswer: As long as you have tried your best, there is no sense in being bothered about failure or success.
references: As long as you have tried your best, there is no sense in being bothered about failure or success.
q67.rubricZh: 原书参考答案印作“As long as you have tried your best, there is no sense being bothered about failure or success.”（there is no sense 后漏印介词 in，手册例句作 there is no sense in doing），经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为现参考答案。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “只要”= as long as；“为……苦恼”= bother about / be bothered about；“做……没有道理”常说 there is no sense in doing sth.。

q68.sampleAnswer: Mass media such as newspapers, television and the Internet keep us informed of what is going on both at home and abroad.
references: Mass media such as newspapers, television and the Internet keep us informed of what is going on both at home and abroad.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “让某人了解”= keep sb. informed of；“国内外”= both at home and abroad。
